name: ivory-coast-social-contributions
description: Use this Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast) reference for CNPS contributions and CMU in 2026, for employers, salaried employees and travailleurs indépendants (RSTI). Match requests such as CNPS contributions, cotisations sociales Côte d'Ivoire, Ivory Coast social security, retraite CNPS, prestations familiales, accident du travail rate, CMU contribution, how much CNPS do I pay, employer social charges Ivory Coast, assiette plafonnée, plafond CNPS, a DISA/DASC annual declaration, an appel de cotisations, and CNPS débits on SGCI, BICICI, Ecobank, NSIA or Coris statements. It ties each rate to its text, holds the ceiling decrees and sends ITS, FDFP and other payroll taxes to ivory-coast-payroll. Read it before any CNPS-related work. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a tax position.
